scope: Baseline for the five non-EmbeddingGemma engines on the Studio: ONNX dense, Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B (candle CPU), SPLADE sparse, BGE-M3 dense+sparse, BGE reranker. Captured twice - once under heavy unrelated load, once in a quiet window - so the difference is measured rather than assumed.

quiet_window_load.note: Runs started at load ~3.0 on 24 logical CPUs; unrelated work resumed near the end, which is why the report keeps the spread instead of a single number.

build.features: qwen3 (dense candle); ONNX default for fastembed backends

protocol.cases: scripts/parity/eg2_cases_text.json short suite (18 rows incl. ragged and reversed batch)
protocol.per_run: 3 warmups, 5 samples of >=200 ms each per case, medians
protocol.across_runs: 4 separate processes per engine per capture; outputs compared exactly within and across captures
protocol.noise_control: two captures at different host load; same-binary spread reported for each

determinism.within_process: every timed call re-checked against the first result
determinism.across_processes: 4/4 processes identical for all five engines, in both captures
determinism.across_host_load: quiet-window capture is bit-identical to the loaded capture for all five engines and all 8 cases; dense token counts identical too
determinism.meaning: These engines are deterministic on this workload; load changes timing, not output.

verdict.exactness: PASS - outputs invariant across processes and across host load.
verdict.performance: Baseline usable for the five engines on this host: quiet-window same-binary spread is 1.00x (ONNX) to 1.04x (Qwen3), worst per-case 1.03x-1.20x. Under 16-30 load the same binaries spread 1.07x-1.69x, so loaded numbers cannot gate anything.
verdict.use: Compare future changes only against the quiet-window capture, on a host at comparable load, and keep per-case ratios - not one aggregate.

limits: Short suite only; t_long, sparse support on long inputs, rerank tie stability and transport paths are not covered here.
Qwen3 ran on CPU with the candle backend. No CUDA host exists any more (zgx GB10 loaner returned 2026-11-10), so GPU/CUDA/TensorRT coverage is blocked, not skipped-and-passed.
Apple-native Gemma runtimes (CoreML/MLX) remain separately gated and unmeasured here.
No model, prompt, dtype or context change; no production change in this capture.
